text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With Twin Turbo today, something was—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoopsie-daisy!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: (What's with this sharp curve~?! I can't make this turn! What do I do, what do I do~?)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little more speed...
Phew..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, something was—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
One more time from here!
Daaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Something was—different!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo looked like she was about to stop, but
she's caught her second wind past the final corner!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: A brilliantly paced run unlike anything seen before! She showed off some truly magnificent tenacity!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Trainer, Trainer!
Turbo ran super good today!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I usually can't do it, but right at the very end,
I was able to give one more full-power sprint!
choice_data_list: Ah... This is it! This breathing!
Yeah... this is it! This breathing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to the tight turn, even Twin Turbo
had to decelerate for a moment.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She caught her second wind right there, leading to another burst of acceleration.
Something I could never teach her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fukushima Racecourse... taught me that.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right. If I can run like this anytime,
then I've got nothing left to fear!
Time to master it even more perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's time to train at the training camp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, full of fiery spirit,
she took on the challenge, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew, whew...
Why...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I try, it's just not working~~~!!
Waaahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"As expected"...? 
Trainer, do you know why it's not working out?
choice_data_list: Yeah, Turbo can't really understand it theoretically.
Yeah, Turbo can't really wrap her head around that stuff.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gaaah!? Does that mean Turbo's stupid~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go that far. But if she could run
skillfully just as she envisioned, she'd have done it already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Twin Turbo can't quite memorize it with her head.
Then――she'll just have to learn it with her body."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what's this pointy yellow thing?
The kind of stuff they put around construction sites?
choice_data_list: I know, let's run along the outside again and again.
That's right, try running along the outside here several times.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Simulated Fukushima. Simulated spiral curve. I have no choice but to run it over and over until my body intuitively grasps the breathing rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is it, this is it! This is the feeling!
Just like when I ran in Fukushima!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: If I can take the corners at other racetracks with that same feeling...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We've finally found the key to overcoming our weakness.
If I can run while catching a breath mid-race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can run even better than before, even on a major racecourse.
Yes, even in the autumn graded races.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Turbo wants to test this running
in a big race!
I wanna, I wanna, I wanna do it so bad~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being begged like that... makes me ponder.
If I were to test it, I'd definitely
want a course with short straights.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When you think of a racetrack with a short final stretch, you think of Nakayama.
And when it comes to races on the Autumn Classic Road...
choice_data_list: Shall we go for the St. Lite Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let me outline the race. It's a 2,200m GII.
For our first goal of the autumn,
both the distance and the grade are just right.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"The St. Lite Kinen, huh.
All right, then Turbo's gonna give it another shot there!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: To recreate that run I pulled off in Fukushima!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, aiming for autumn's St. Lite Kinen,
days spent mastering a new running style began.
